card.name: Radiation dose tables before organ names
card.fires_on: Last piece of a table header or number just before an organ name (Adrenals, Brain, Spleen) in radiopharmaceutical absorbed-dose tables. Also fires on the start of capitalized warning headings and a drug name.

modes.label: Dose table
modes.description: Unit or number closing a column header or row right before an organ name in an absorbed-dose table.

card.writes: It suppresses organ words like brain, lung, muscle and stomach, so it holds back an organ name from coming next.
card.plain: It fires in radiation dose tables just before the list of organs, and it keeps organ names from being predicted yet.
